scope: Complete local folder including hidden, ignored and untracked files
method_limits: Markdown content reviewed in full; architecture summaries do not copy private editorial bodies
HTML semantic and inline-behavior inspection is not browser acceptance
All PDF pages text-extracted and source-version checked; no all-page pixel-perfect claim
Font metadata and notices reviewed; no independent license or binary-security audit
Minified KaTeX provenance, version and dependency inspection is not full security review
Historical public URLs were read as source claims, not reverified on the internet
Routed advisory coverage and provider attribution were not accepted as proof

structural_observations.project_map: effectful enrollment input; exact plan fingerprint and source-map readback required by owning adapter
structural_observations.capability_hit_map: design_only; global activation false and four cadence modes disabled
